description: Classic 2048 puzzle game for CardputerZero with keyboard controls and sound effects.

store.summary: Classic 2048 puzzle game tuned for the CardputerZero keyboard.
store.description:
Merge matching tiles on a 4 x 4 board and reach 2048. Built for the CardputerZero 320 x 170 display, with a live score, tile sounds, restart confirmation and continued play after reaching the goal.

Controls: F/Z/X/C or W/A/S/D move the tiles; arrow keys are also supported. Press R, then R again to restart; Esc cancels the restart prompt. M toggles sound. Hold Esc or press Q to quit.

Runs offline using the built-in keyboard, display and speaker. No additional hardware is required.
